questions.question: 500 learners go on a trip in buses with 32 seats. How many buses are needed? Explain what happens to the remainder.
questions.expected_answer: 500 divided by 32 is 15 remainder 20. 15 buses carry 480 learners, so 20 learners would be left behind. Every learner must go, so one more bus is needed: 16 buses.

questions.question: 350 bread rolls are packed 12 to a pack. How many full packs are there, and how many rolls are left over?
questions.expected_answer: 350 divided by 12 is 29 remainder 2, because 29 times 12 is 348. There are 29 full packs and 2 rolls left over.

questions.question: 72 sweets are shared between Naledi and Sipho in the ratio 1 to 2. How many does each get?
questions.expected_answer: The ratio has 1 plus 2, which is 3 parts. 72 divided by 3 is 24, so one part is 24 sweets. Naledi gets 1 part, 24 sweets, and Sipho gets 2 parts, 48 sweets. Check: 24 plus 48 is 72.
